original.reason: It uses \(\sup(-A)\) without establishing that \(-A\) is nonempty and bounded above, hence that its supremum exists. This follows readily from the assumptions but is required for a complete proof.

judgment.reason: It establishes existence of \(\sup(-A)\), proves its negation is a lower bound of \(A\), and proves every lower bound is at most it.
It correctly establishes the needed supremum and verifies both defining properties of the infimum.
It correctly proves \(-A\) is nonempty and bounded above, then proves \(-\sup(-A)\) is the greatest lower bound.
It correctly justifies existence of the supremum and proves the requisite lower-bound and greatestness properties.
